glossary.meaning: Dad's record fuel economy: 59.7 MPG on the hybrid, driving home to the temple on a Saturday. He showed the dashboard screen to everyone in the temple parking lot, the priest included, and brings it up whenever anyone mentions driving.

On the family's Switzerland trip this summer Mom bought six 1 kg bags of Lindt chocolate as gifts for the relatives, and Dad carried them through three trains and two airports. Any big chocolate shopping trip is now a 'Lindt run'.
Telugu for 'dad'. Telugu parents also call their children 'nanna' as an affectionate 'dear', which is how Dad uses it with Arjun and Diya.
Telugu for 'both of you' ('iddariki' = 'for both of you'). Dad and Mom use it when talking to Arjun and Diya together.
Telugu for 'you did well' ('baga' = well, good). Praise from a parent.
Telugu for 'what happened?'. A worried parent's check-in.
Telugu for 'did you eat?'. Mom's way of checking in.
Telugu exclamation, roughly 'oh no!'. Sympathy or alarm.

messages.text:
🌅 *Good Morning* 🌅

A cup of tea is best enjoyed slowly. So is life ☕
Do not hurry. Do not worry.
Smile at the first person you meet today 😊

Have a blessed Sunday 🙏🌸

☘️ #Common_Mistakes ☘️

Don't say ❌ "I am having two brothers"
Say ✅ "I have two brothers"

Don't say ❌ "Please revert back to me"
Say ✅ "Please reply to me" (revert already means go back)

Don't say ❌ "We discussed about the matter"
Say ✅ "We discussed the matter"

Don't say ❌ "He is my cousin brother"
Say ✅ "He is my cousin"

Share with your children and grandchildren 🙏
True. 'Revert back' I see in office every day 🤣
I will show this to my class 😊
Very good Lakshmi. Teach them early 👍
Planning to go to the city Saturday for Diwali shopping. Indian stores have very good collection this year 👌
Last time 2 hours one way. Order online only.

*Useful tips for airport journey* ✈️

1. Keep a copy of passport and visa in your email
2. Put one set of clothes in hand luggage, checked bag can come late
3. Take photo of your bag before check-in
4. Empty water bottle is allowed, fill after security
5. Reach 3 hours early for international, 2 hours for domestic
6. Wear comfortable shoes, long walk in big airports 👟
Kindly watch above, very helpful for travel friends 🙏
Point 2 is very important. Our bag came late on Swiss trip 😱
Ravi showed me his car mileage at temple today 😊 59.7.. very proud man

messages.text: Good morning nanna ☀️ Have a nice week. Study well 📚

☘️ #Common_Mistakes ☘️

Don't say ❌ "Today morning I went for walk"
Say ✅ "This morning I went for a walk"

Don't say ❌ "Kindly do the needful"
Say ✅ "Please take care of it"

Don't say ❌ "Let us prepone the meeting"
Say ✅ "Let us move the meeting earlier"

Small corrections make a big impression 👌 Forwarded as received.

😀 Teacher: Why are you late again?
Student: Sir, on the road there was a board, "School ahead, go slow" 🐢
Teacher: 🤦

😀 Moral: Read the full sign before you follow it 😀😀

*Health tips after 50* 🌿 (forwarded as received)

👉 Drink one glass of warm water when you wake up ✅
👉 Walk 30 minutes daily, even slowly ✅
👉 Finish dinner before 8 pm ✅
👉 Less sugar, less salt, more smiling ✅
👉 Sleep 7 hours, keep phone away from bed ✅

Share with all your near and dear ones 🙏
Your mother says you are eating only noodles. Eat dal and rice, it is good for the brain 🧠
Read one hour extra daily. Do not study after 12 at night, memory will not stay 🙏

🌸 *Good Morning* 🌸

Sunday is for family, rest and gratitude.
Call someone you have not called in a long time 📞

Have a peaceful Sunday 🙏

👉 Tip: Keep the phone away 30 minutes before sleep ✅
